propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked WIP to prevent unintended submission, since ticket comments and session logs are invisible to submitters.
The contribution flow lacks documented guidance on using Gerrit's WIP mechanism to enforce holds on changes with known review findings or defects.
Documentation at three surfaces (CONTRIBUTING.md, passing-code-review.md guide, and AGENTS.md) must consistently surface the WIP hold rule to reach all author and agent code paths.
Both WIP application methods must be documented: push-time syntax (refs/for/main%wip) and REST toggle (POST /a/changes/<n>/wip) for existing changes.
The packaged code-review guide must surface the rule through the registry mapping so it is reachable via rebar explain review without opening CONTRIBUTING.md.
